window_note: Rolling feed of deeply-researched picks (moneylines, totals, spreads, player/match props, and parlays) across the full confidence spectrum, refreshed hourly but only updated when something genuinely changed. Confidence tracks the specificity of the evidence. Only games that haven't started yet are included. Nothing here is ever a guaranteed outcome, however lopsided it looks.

picks.matchup: New York Jets at Kansas City Chiefs
reasoning: Jets are 2-6 and will be without WR Garrett Wilson (concussion) and LB Trevin Wallace (groin); RB Breece Hall is expected back.

Chiefs are at home with Patrick Mahomes a full participant all week despite a knee issue. They started 5-0 but have lost two straight (Seahawks, Broncos), and CB Mansoor Delane and DT Peter Woods are out.
Posted moneyline is about Chiefs -550 / Jets +400-410 (roughly 82% no-vig), with Kansas City -9.5. Estimate shaded to 79% for the two-game losing streak and Mahomes' knee.
Start time is a fallback of 1:00 pm ET (18:00Z), based on coverage calling it a rare early-afternoon Arrowhead game; the exact kickoff was not confirmed.

picks.matchup: Las Vegas Raiders at San Francisco 49ers
reasoning: 49ers are 6-1 and rested off a Week 8 bye at Levi's Stadium; Raiders are 4-4 under first-year coach Klint Kubiak, with only CB Darien Porter (groin) notable as questionable.

San Francisco injury picture is mixed: Christian McCaffrey returned to full practice Friday per the team, but other previews list him questionable, and Nick Bosa (knee/calf) is questionable. Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel were absent from early practice.
Posted moneyline is about 49ers -455 to -490 / Raiders +350 to +370 (roughly 80% no-vig), with the 49ers favored by about 9.5. Estimate shaded to 77% for the skill-player and Bosa uncertainty.
Kickoff is 1:25 pm PT / 4:25 pm ET (21:25Z).
Lions are 5-2 and have won three straight, including 19-15 over the Vikings; Jahmyr Gibbs ran for 153 yards and a score last week.
Dolphins are 1-6, coming off a 24-19 home loss to the Patriots, and are without RB De'Von Achane (ACL, out since Week 3).

Posted moneyline is about Lions -325 to -350 / Dolphins +260 to +275 (roughly 75% no-vig), with Detroit -7. One analyst sees a flat spot for Detroit after an emotional home win, and a Lions defender named Campbell may be injured (unclear), so the estimate stays at 74%.
Kickoff is 1:00 pm ET (18:00Z) in Miami Gardens.

settled.matchup: Minnesota Golden Gophers at Indiana Hoosiers
reasoning: Real posted moneylines: Indiana -2300 at one book and -2500 or longer at another (about 96% before margin; 1.04 payout used as the multiplier). Kalshi has Indiana at about 92-93%, so I used 92%. The spread is Indiana -20.5 with a low total of 40.5-41.5. The payout is very thin.

Indiana (No. 4) are at home in Bloomington and their defense is a strength. Main risks: QB Josh Hoover is listed as probable, Indiana are only 1-6 against the spread while Minnesota are 5-2 against the spread, and a low total means one fluky possession can matter. I found no full Minnesota injury report. Previews disagree on whether this is Week 8 or Week 9, but the date and time agree.
Kickoff is 3:30 pm ET (19:30Z, 2:30 pm CT) at Memorial Stadium.

settled.matchup: Virginia Cavaliers at Wake Forest Demon Deacons
reasoning: Real posted moneyline: Wake Forest -520 / Virginia +390 (about 84% before margin; 1.19 payout used as the multiplier). Dimers' model gives Wake Forest 82.4%, so I used 83%. The spread is Wake Forest -11.5 to -14.5 with a total around 49.

Wake Forest are 6-1 and at home; Virginia are 4-4 with more than a dozen players on the ACC injury report as out (DBs Brandyn Hillman and Ethan Minter questionable). Sportsbook Review's model projects a 38-20 Wake Forest win.

Main risks: spread sources range widely (-11.5 to -14.5), one outlet (Docsports) likes Virginia +14.5, and I did not verify Wake Forest's own injury report. Kickoff 3:45 pm ET (19:45Z, 2:45 pm CT) on ESPN2.

Real posted moneylines: DraftKings Bengals -625 / Titans +455 (1.16 payout used as the multiplier), Betfanatics -575 / +420, Rotowire -525 / +490, about 84-86% before margin. Covers puts Cincinnati near 83%; BetMGM's model is lower at 74.2%, so I used 84%, just under the market. The spread is Bengals -10 to -10.5 with a total of 46.5-47.

Burrow is playing at a high level and Cincinnati converts 50.6% of third downs, best in the NFL; Tennessee rank 32nd in yards per game and are 1-12 at home since the 2025 season. Squawka projects Cincinnati 30-13.

Main risks: Bengals WR Andrei Iosivas is out (thumb) and TE Erick All Jr. and S Kyle Dugger left last week's game hurt; I could not find a dated full injury report, so check it before kickoff. Sources disagree on kickoff time (Action Network showed 6 pm), but most say 1:00 pm ET. Daylight time ends Nov 1, 2026, so 1:00 pm ET is 18:00Z (12:00 pm CT).

Real posted moneylines: DraftKings Cowboys -285 / Cardinals +230 (1.35 payout used as the multiplier), Fox Sports -340 / +270, VegasInsider -310 / +250, about 74-77% before margin. Kalshi has Dallas near 72% and BetMGM's model 71.6%, so I used 72%. The spread is Cowboys -6 to -6.5 with a 54.5 total.

Arizona are on a 5-game skid, and QB Kyler Murray is not expected to start (he could play). The Cardinals have conceded 26 touchdowns in seven games, the most in the NFL, while Dallas just beat the Eagles 38-21 and project to have their offensive line intact for the first time since Week 2. Squawka projects Dallas 27-17.

Main risks: BetMGM's model leans Arizona against the spread (63.7%), Murray could still play, a high total keeps the game volatile, and I found no full dated Cowboys injury report. Kickoff Daylight time ends Nov 1, 2026, so 1:00 pm ET is 18:00Z (12:00 pm CT).

settled.matchup: Los Angeles Chargers at Los Angeles Rams
reasoning: Real posted moneylines: DraftKings Rams -290 / Chargers +235 (1.34 payout used as the multiplier) and FanDuel -295 / +240, about 74% before margin. Models are mixed: Kalshi 73%, Stats Insider 75%, numberFire 87%, so I used 76%. The spread is Rams -6.5 with a total of 44.5.

Squawka projects a 26-16 Rams win and Stats Insider 26-18. Injuries: Rams TE Colby Parkinson is questionable (shoulder); on the Chargers side James and Awosika did not practice Wednesday while McConkey practiced fully. I could not find final injury reports.

Main risks: a six-point-plus spread in a division-style crosstown game with a low total can stay close, and final injury statuses were not confirmed. Kickoff 4:05 pm ET; daylight time ends Nov 1, 2026, so that is 21:05Z (3:05 pm CT) at SoFi Stadium.
settled.final_score: Los Angeles Rams 24, Los Angeles Chargers 9

settled.matchup: New England Patriots at Miami Dolphins
reasoning: Real posted moneylines: DraftKings Patriots -395 / Dolphins +310 (1.25 payout used as the multiplier), Fox Sports -330 / +265, VegasInsider -325 / +260, about 77-80% before margin. Kalshi has New England near 78% and Stats Insider's model 74%, so I used 77%. The spread is Patriots -6.5 to -7.5 with a total of 44.5.

Miami only got their first win of the season last week (28-25 over the Jets) and allow a 116.8 opponent passer rating, the worst in the NFL; Quinn Ewers starts at quarterback. Covers picks the Patriots 25-21 and Squawka projects 26-17.

Main risks: The Spread notes a slew of Dolphins injuries could still make it close, I could not find a reliable 2026 injury report for either side, and the Patriots' 25-21 projection is only a four-point margin. Kickoff 4:25 pm ET. Daylight time ends Nov 1, 2026, so that is 21:25Z (3:25 pm CT).
settled.final_score: New England Patriots 24, Miami Dolphins (13 or 19; sources differ on Miami total)
